title: Sent from Shittim
text: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim …

title: Inspect the Land
text: Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.

title: In Rahab's House
text: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim, saying, “Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.”

title: Reported to the King
text: Behold, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.

title: Bring Out the Men
text: Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house …

title: Hidden
text: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them.

title: Pursue Them Quickly
text: Pursue them quickly, and you may catch them!

title: Among the Stalks of Flax
text: But Rahab had taken them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had laid out there.

title: The Gate Was Shut
text: … and as soon as they had gone out, the gate was shut.

title: The LORD Has Given You This Land
text: I know that the LORD has given you this land …

title: Melting in Fear
text: … so that all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of you.

title: We Have Heard
text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt …

title: God in Heaven and on Earth
text: … for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.

title: Show Kindness
text: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD that you will indeed show kindness to my family, because I showed kindness to you.

title: A Sure Sign
text: Give me a sure sign that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them …

title: Our Lives for Your Lives
text: Our lives for your lives!

title: Down by a Rope
text: Then Rahab let them down by a rope through the window …

title: Built into the Wall
text: … since the house where she lived was built into the wall of the city.

title: Three Days in the Hills
text: Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned; then go on your way.

title: The Scarlet Cord
text: … unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down …

title: All Your Family in the House
text: … and unless you have brought your father and mother and brothers and all your family into your house.

title: She Tied the Cord
text: And when they had gone, she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

title: Inside the House
text: If anyone goes out the door of your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be innocent.

title: The Oath
text: And if you report our mission, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.

title: Delivered into Our Hands
text: The LORD has surely delivered the entire land into our hands, | Indeed, all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of us.

title: Melting in Fear of Us
text: Indeed, all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of us.

title: By Faith
text: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.

title: Rahab in Jesus' Family
text: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,

title: The Fear Has Fallen
text: … the fear of you has fallen on us …

title: Father and Mother
text: … and unless you have brought your father and mother and brothers and all your family into your house.

title: Brothers and Sisters
text: … that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them …
